ruling: - **R38. The repeat judge skips its own thread and marks without blocking.** Read 13:00 CST Nov 11: decision owner-feedback-inbox, Repeats (owner 2026-11-01 17:57 CST, "a model's meaning match, no glossary") made 8 marks today, 0 true. Two causes: one candidate is given to every item in a Stop, and a session's follow-up items match its own earlier items on the same owner message. Owner 13:03 CST: "yes on the fix !". 1. The judge skips a candidate on the item's own home or the same owner message. 2. Each item gets its own candidates. 3. A mark prints one line and never blocks the turn. The meaning match stays, so a repeat in other words (the carousel and wheel incident) is still caught. Home: decision owner-feedback-inbox, Repeats, rewritten in place.
quote: a model's meaning match, no glossary; yes on the fix !
